user_authorization.scope: execute converged v1 autonomously; local3090 deployment or bounded remote idle-GPU waiting

deadline_scope: all waiting and GPU work ends by this fixed deadline, no rolling extension; runtime timeout includes cleanup within deadline
execution_topology: one allocated GPU at a time; no phase concurrency; job-owned server/planner on same allocation; if it cannot fit do not use a second unbudgeted GPU
accounting: reserve full allowed invocation time durably before load, deduct actual monotonic wall*allocated unique GPUs including failed starts/initialization/idle server/cleanup; release unused reservation after verified own-process cleanup; no reset on restart
local_memory_note: 24GiB=24576MiB; V model-only is provisional, M2 must verify model+planner/simulator coexistence and allocator/global memory evidence; sampled peaks not continuous proof

validation_auto_tolerance.full_final_normalized_and_physical_actio: bitwise equal, finite; ignore timestamps/path/device labels only
validation_auto_tolerance.repeat: same request twice, both match immutable reference; do not replace reference with local outputs
validation_auto_tolerance.nonzero_tolerance: not auto-approved; log residuals and fall back to remote candidate once, never widen acceptance based on observed drift
validation_auto_tolerance.prompt: prefer original GPU encoding before offload; CPU prompt encoding may change arithmetic and is not presumed equivalent

backend_selection: V can attempt local once then remote once if needed; choose one validated backend manifest for Q/M2/M3; same host/backend/GPU allocation for an episode and all compared arms, no local/remote pooling or silent backend change

wait.on_unknown: record error, no admission; next scheduled slot only
wait.on_deadline: stop and report not_run/incomplete; no retries/extension
wait.scope: user-authorized resource waiting only, never restart P1B or conversation watchers

joint_bundle_scope: one exact cross-reviewed M0 threshold + M1 controller/seed selector + runtime/input + validators + policy bundle; stages advance by pinned validator receipts, no per-stage user approval
M2_promotion: engineering validity only, never rescue/success effect or best condition
V_conditions: unchanged reviewed generation path and pinned reference/source/config/weights with residency-only engineering change, full provenance; new sampler/model logic requires review before run
retries: no invocation reruns or directory replacement; all failures consume cap; process/engineering failure halts stage, do not select another seed to hide it
partial: if qualification lacks target or M2 incomplete stop; M3 cap/deadline produces incomplete all-N report with missing rows, no silent complete-case replacement
